decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric sits close to the firm's core upholstery expertise and has its own page, so in-house R&D and design knowledge let management read early results and refine it.
This decorative bouclé-effect fabric is close to the established offer, so the firm can assimilate feedback, though its lower website visibility suggests a smaller role in the collection.
A flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric for contract and hospitality markets draws directly on the firm's functional-fabric know-how and has a dedicated page, making it a strong keep.
The double-face wool-blend fabric builds on existing knowledge and fits the shift to renewable materials, which gives R&D a basis for learning and improving it.
The wool bouclé leno fabric extends the firm's established semi-transparent and wool expertise and suits its sustainability direction, so management can interpret and build on early results.
